batch-functions.composition: Oracle counts every function-like node (function/method/arrow/function-expression/generator); the producer emits one fact only for a function whose span holds a `.batch(`/`.transaction(` call. Residual = the large majority of functions that hold no batch/transaction call.

code-block.composition: Oracle counts block nodes (functions/classes/control-flow) plus `object`/`call_expression` fragment nodes; the producer projects DRY blocks and fragments with dedup and a declared-value filter. Residual = object literals and call expressions outside a declared value, plus the dedup of methods emitted through both the function and class walks.

cross-language-entities.composition: Oracle counts entity-declaring nodes (function/method/arrow/interface, Go `type_spec`); the producer projects named entities, folding methods/arrows into their containing entity and emitting a Go `type_spec` only when it declares a struct/interface. Residual = folded members and non-entity type declarations.

ddl-declarations.composition: Oracle counts DDL statement headers (CREATE/DROP/ALTER TABLE) off source text; the producer emits one op per CREATE/DROP/ALTER-RENAME matched by its own DDL_RE. Residual = ALTER TABLE … ADD COLUMN/ADD CONSTRAINT headers, which the producer records in tableColumns rather than as an op.

export-form.composition: Oracle counts `export_statement` nodes; the producer emits one `(name, isDefault)` fact per statement `extractExports` can name (the first named export of a multi-name clause). Residual = namespace re-exports (`export * from '…'`) and empty clauses (`export {}`) that name nothing.

file-imports.composition: Oracle counts `import_statement` (TS/JS) and `import_spec` (Go) nodes; the producer's `imports` array is a deduped set. Residual = duplicate specifiers (a name imported more than once).

file-symbols.composition: Oracle counts function-like + class + interface declaration nodes; the producer folds methods into their class symbol. Residual = methods (and other members) riding on a class symbol.

function-index.composition: Oracle counts `function_declaration` + `arrow_function`; the producer emits an arrow only when bound to a variable declarator. Residual = bare callback arrows (legitimately skipped).

import-form.composition: Oracle counts `import_statement` nodes; the producer re-runs a per-line source-text regex classifier (`parseFileImports`) that recognizes fewer forms. Residual = statements the classifier does not project (multi-line imports, `import type`, inline `{ type X }`).

react-component.composition: Oracle counts `jsx_element` + `jsx_self_closing_element` nodes; the producer sums each component's `jsxElementDetails` (one per JSX occurrence, nested included). Residual = JSX that sits outside a component.

style-declarations.composition: Oracle counts every `declaration` node in the file; the producer projects only declarations inside a `rule_set` (and may expand a shorthand into several). Residual = declarations outside a rule_set (`@keyframes`/`@font-face`/`@page`), not shorthand expansion.

type-declarations.composition: Oracle counts Go `type_spec` nodes (exempting `*_test.go`); the producer emits only struct/interface type specs. Residual = non-struct/interface declarations (aliases, `func`/slice/map types).
